input: I am about to write into the P1 findings memo the finding that the pre-pivot business pack's revenue model is obsolete in structure, not just in numbers: it prices 29 paid skills per-call at competitor-anchored rates from 0.0025 to 0.50 dollars, while the adopted and built model is Option D per-loop billing at a 0.02 dollar base with token-cost overage, and the product surface itself consolidated from a skill catalog to a substrate contract. The Month-12 projection of 10,329 dollars per month rests on the removed catalog, so it cannot be carried forward even as an anchor. I judge this finding accurate and material because every downstream break-even figure inherits it.
